diagnostic: The exact Steam review hub requires login, and independent public discovery yielded too little directly inspectable, substantive player feedback to substantiate strengths, weaknesses, technical state and 12-dimension coverage. Similar adult games have different AppIDs and cannot be substituted. Preserve this per-item evidence gap rather than manufacture a strict final dossier.

operations.summary: Inspected indexed SteamDB game identity, age restriction and release metadata for the exact AppID.
Direct Steam Community review hub returned a logged-in-only access error; individual reviews could not be inspected.
Search snippets surfaced primarily joking or short comments and ambiguous comparisons to similarly named but different AppIDs; not sufficient for a balanced dossier.
